operating_notes.text: FY26 inventory rose to ₹5,296 Cr from ₹3,299 Cr, absorbing ₹2,025 Cr of working capital and driving operating cash flow to negative ₹789 Cr.
Gold metal loans fell to ₹776 Cr from ₹1,182 Cr while current borrowings rose to ₹1,569 Cr from ₹586 Cr.
The company operates as a single 'jewellery business' segment per Ind AS 108.
Showroom network expanded to 201 showrooms with 26 new showrooms launched in FY26.
Old gold exchange reached 50% of total revenue in Q4 FY26, helping mitigate high gold price impacts.
Sennes (lab-grown diamond) business turned EBITDA-positive in its second year across 12 exclusive stores.
Old gold exchange accounted for 43% of sales quantity on a blended basis
Diamond jewellery sales increased by 43% in value and 18% in volume
Average gold price rose by 61% YoY and 1% QoQ
Senco Gold is currently the Master Franchisee for AJPL's 20 stores.
AJPL operates the 'Melorra' brand of fast-fashion lightweight jewellery.
The investment is a primary subscription of fresh equity, with funds to be used for growth/expansion and discharge of old liabilities.

timeline.summary: Senco Gold extended the expected completion date for the August Jewellery Private Limited (Melorra) acquisition to June 30, 2026.
Jai Hanuman Shri Siddhivinayak Trust’s **Suvankar Sen (Promoter)** disclosed 105,630,647 shares held as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrance during FY2026.

Senco Gold Limited’s **Mukund Chandak** (signed digitally) announced a Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on **May 27, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST**, featuring **Suvankar Sen (MD & CEO)** and **Sanjay Banka (Group CFO & IR Head)**.
Senco Gold Limited’s **Mukund Chandak** announced a physical **Annual Investor Conference** with **360 ONE Capital (B&K)** and **TRINITY INDIA 2026** on **29 May 2026** at Grand Hyatt, Kurla, Mumbai.
Senco Gold reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹8,430 Cr and PAT of ₹574 Cr; the board recommended a ₹1 per share final dividend.
Senco Gold reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹8,430 Cr and PAT of ₹574 Cr, proposing a final dividend of 20%.
On May 27, 2026, Senco Gold hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, reporting strong revenue of ₹1,997 Cr and guiding for 18-20% growth in FY27.

Senco Gold Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on 12 August 2026, reporting record revenue of ₹3,000 Cr (+67% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 7%, while maintaining FY27 guidance of 20%+ revenue growth and 7.5%-7.8% EBITDA margin.
Senco Gold signed agreements to acquire a 68% stake in Melorra brand owner August Jewellery Private Limited for ₹68 crore, expected to complete by February 2027.
